rules.reported: Companions cannot stack Galvanized mods on their own weapons by themselves. If the player has the same Galvanized mod on their primary, the player's kills trigger it so the companion also gets the benefit.
rules.build_impact: A Galvanized mod on a companion weapon is only worth it if the matching mod is also on your primary.
rules.creator_caveat: The creator says they personally don't run these on companion weapons.

wiki.detail: Notes say only kills from the weapon holding the mod give stacks and only that weapon benefits; the one listed sharing case is exalted weapons, and companions are not covered.

rules.text_says: The description does not mention any effect on Eximus units.
rules.reported: While Silence is active, Eximus enemies in range lose their abilities and can only shoot, and their bubbles pop when you come into range. The abilities return as soon as Silence ends.
rules.build_impact: Silence works as a strong defensive anti-Eximus tool, so it is worth keeping up with duration rather than treating it as a stealth utility.

wiki.detail: The Silence status stops abilities, special attacks and Eximus effects for all enemies in range, including Overguard ones.

rules.reported: Casting Wil-O-Wisp and then Breach Surge makes the Wil-O-Wisp clones send out their own Breach Surges as well.
rules.build_impact: Casting in that order multiplies the Breach Surge coverage without any extra modding.

wiki.detail: Casting Breach Surge while the Wil-O-Wisp clone travels makes a second surge around the clone.

rules.reported: Subsumed Vial Rush or Reave on Ivara does not break Prowl, so she can move quickly while staying invisible. Vial Rush costs no energy and runs on a 5-second cooldown.
rules.build_impact: A stealth Ivara can use her Helminth slot on Vial Rush to fix Prowl's slow movement at no energy cost.
rules.creator_caveat: The creator calls this more of a tip than a hidden mechanic.

rules.text_says: The description does not mention knockdown protection.
rules.reported: Garuda cannot be knocked down while Dread Mirror is active.
rules.build_impact: Garuda can skip knockdown-immunity mods as long as Dread Mirror is kept up.

wiki.detail: The shield blocks stagger and knockdown, but not knockback that launches the player.

rules.reported: Valence Formation's element buff seems to work on anything that shoots. An unmodded Mausolon, which should only deal heat, puncture and impact, applied cold procs. A Sunpoint plasma drill also applied cold, a tranq rifle applied heat, and a fishing spear was tried as well.
rules.build_impact: Lavos can add status elements to weapons you wouldn't expect to accept them, so weapon choice is less limited by base damage types.
rules.creator_caveat: The creator could not think of a practical use for the tool cases.

wiki.detail: Applies to all of Lavos weapons with a guaranteed proc as a universal weapon bonus; gear items such as the tranq rifle or fishing spear are not mentioned.

rules.reported: While flying with his first ability, Uriel can still use weapon secondary fire, letting him bomb from the air.
rules.build_impact: Weapons with a strong alt-fire pair well with Uriel's flight.

wiki.detail: Alternate fire does not interrupt flight, while normal ranged fire does.

rules.reported: Archon Stretch does work on Caliban, but only with the Razor Mortar augment. Plain fire from his Sentient summons does not trigger it, while Razor Mortar hits trigger it repeatedly.
rules.build_impact: Caliban only gets Archon Stretch's energy regeneration if Razor Mortar is in the build.
rules.creator_caveat: The creator notes this contradicts what other YouTubers have said.

wiki.detail: Razor Mortar Ortholyst electricity procs Archon Stretch, fixed in Update 39.1; Archon Stretch lists Caliban.

rules.reported: Galvanized Acceleration and Fatal Acceleration extend the teleport distance of the alt-fire, probably because it is tied to the falloff stat.
rules.build_impact: A projectile speed mod also gives this weapon longer mobility reach.
rules.creator_caveat: The falloff link is the creator's guess. The captions say "Cedo Basmu"; read as Coda Bassocyst because it has an alt-fire and takes shotgun mods, which Basmu (a rifle with no alt-fire) does not.

wiki.detail: Fatal and Galvanized Acceleration extend the alt-fire finisher range; its falloff is also tied to projectile speed.

rules.text_says: Unique Microwave trait that enlarges enemy body parts.
rules.reported: The game counts the Microwave enlargement as its own status effect, so it adds a status type for Galvanized Savvy and Condition Overload style mods, giving extra damage.
rules.build_impact: Status-count damage mods get a free extra stack on this weapon.
rules.creator_caveat: The creator says only "the new core" in the captions; read here as Nukor.

wiki.detail: Microwave counts as its own status for Condition Overload and Galvanized Aptitude, Savvy and Shot, and has infinite duration.

rules.text_says: The creator says the game explains the link between projectile speed and damage falloff poorly.
rules.reported: Projectile speed mods improve damage falloff. At exactly 25 m an unmodded test weapon mostly hit for 3 per shot; with Fatal Acceleration every shot hit for at least 25.
rules.build_impact: Falloff weapons used at range should consider a projectile speed mod as a real damage increase.

wiki.detail: Projectile speed modifiers shift falloff ranges on weapons with listed falloff, and Fatal Acceleration fits all shotguns for this reason.

rules.reported: The number of glaives fired by the alt-fire follows modded multishot: one glaive with no multishot, and more as multishot is added.
rules.build_impact: Multishot mods directly add glaives, so they matter more on Cedo than their listed number suggests.

wiki.detail: Multishot sets the number of glaives per use.

rules.text_says: The bonus is supposed to be additive.
rules.reported: On Cedo, Galvanized Savvy's damage increase acts multiplicatively rather than additively.
rules.build_impact: Galvanized Savvy should always be in a Cedo build if you own it.

wiki.detail: Multiplicative only on direct alt-fire glaive hits with base damage mods; primary fire stays additive and explosions do not get the bonus.

rules.text_says: Extra health while channeled abilities are active.
rules.reported: It counts every one of Hildryn's abilities even though not all of them are channeled, and it also works on many other frames' abilities that shouldn't qualify. The creator points to the wiki list of qualifying abilities.
rules.build_impact: Check the qualifying list before ruling this arcane out, because it can add health on frames with no obvious channeled ability.
rules.creator_caveat: The captions say "Arcane Contention"; corrected by matching the effect to Arcane Intention's text.

wiki.detail: The qualifying list includes all four Hildryn abilities (Pillage only during its expansion) and many non-channeled abilities elsewhere.

rules.text_says: Must be triggered using a pistol.
rules.reported: Once triggered, the ammo efficiency applies to all of your weapons, not only the pistol.
rules.build_impact: A pistol can trigger it to feed ammo-hungry primaries, such as the Kuva Ogris the creator mentions.

later_patch.detail: Effect changed from ammo efficiency to a 60% chance of Infinite Ammo for 12 s; 44.0.0 (2026-09-23) changed the trigger from headshot kill to weak point kill.

wiki.detail: Current text matches the patch and says the buff also works on primary weapons once a secondary triggers it.

rules.reported: Throwing a Surging Blades blade into a Kompressa bubble makes the bubble very large and traps the blade inside, where it keeps damaging enemies who touch it. Damage looked decent.
rules.build_impact: Pairing Surging Blades with Kompressa creates a large lingering damage zone.
rules.creator_caveat: The creator could not tell whether the blade inherits stats from the bubble.

wiki.detail: Lists a hidden synergy where bubbles capture Surging Blades, grow and damage nearby enemies.

rules.reported: The order of a companion's precept mods sets their priority, which determines how often each ability is used. The order runs from the top left to the bottom right, as with combining elements.
rules.build_impact: Put the companion ability you want used most in the top-left slot.

wiki.detail: Top left precept slot has highest priority and bottom right lowest.

rules.reported: Starting mission energy depends on unused mod capacity. A build with 2 capacity free started at roughly half energy, and one with 60 of 60 free started full. The creator estimates 5 starting energy per unused capacity point.
rules.build_impact: Leaving capacity unused gives more energy at the start of a mission, so a tightly packed build starts lower.
rules.creator_caveat: The 5-per-point figure is the creator's estimate and doesn't obviously fit the half-energy result at 2 free capacity.

wiki.detail: Starting energy equals base starting energy plus 5 per free mod capacity point, so a build with 2 free can still start near half.

rules.reported: Having a dagger equipped grants a hidden movement speed bonus of 5 to 10%, depending on the dagger.
rules.build_impact: Dagger melee adds a little free speed.

wiki.detail: Single daggers give a hidden +10% movement speed and dual daggers +5% while held.

rules.reported: While Yareli rides Merulina, her companion can trigger primary arcanes, shown with Primary Merciless.
rules.build_impact: A Merulina build can trigger primary arcanes through the companion.
rules.creator_caveat: The creator jokes it is probably spaghetti code.

rules.reported: The Amalgam Argonak Metal Auger on the primary lets any dagger strip armor. With a gas and electric Melee Influence build, the strip reaches a wide area using only melee.
rules.build_impact: Casters without a good area armor strip can get one from Argonak and a dagger instead of using a Helminth slot.

wiki.detail: Dagger damage including status procs strips armor, and procs spread by Melee Influence also trigger it.

rules.reported: Companions can pick up Reservoirs motes. With Manifold Bond, their shock motes also spread any elements modded onto the companion's weapon, so enemies not yet shot had heat and viral on top of electricity procs.
rules.build_impact: A companion with Manifold Bond and modded elements primes enemies over a wide area for Condition Overload style weapons.
rules.creator_caveat: The creator admits the Verglas shown doesn't benefit from priming.

wiki.detail: Companions can pluck Reservoir motes, and Manifold Bond triggers on the Shock Mote.

rules.reported: Using Safeguard Switch on a Kuva Harvester in Kuva Survival makes it temporarily invincible, and it can be recast when it ends. Modding for duration extends it.
rules.build_impact: Loki with Safeguard Switch and high duration can protect harvesters during Kuva farming.
rules.creator_caveat: In the demo the creator got trapped inside the harvester.

rules.reported: Blood Altar is a very easy way to build melee combo, and Nidus's Parasitic Link works the same way. The creator suggests it for the Riven challenge that needs a combo of 6 held for 30 seconds.
rules.build_impact: Either ability provides an easy melee combo source for melee builds and Riven challenges.

wiki.detail: Melee hits on an invulnerable altar target still raise combo; Parasitic Link notes the same for linked enemies.

rules.reported: Exalted weapons with heat modded on can trigger Arcane Hot Shot. It worked best on Jade's Glory, since the heat proc lands before enemies die, and it seemed to stay at maximum stacks while enemies remained.
rules.build_impact: Exalted builds can get the arcane's crit stacks simply by modding heat on the exalted weapon.

wiki.detail: Exalted weapons modded for Heat acquire and maintain stacks, and fatal hits still grant stacks.

rules.reported: Word Warden, obtained by casting Light Verse, Dark Verse then Final Verse, triggers whichever secondary arcane is on Noctua even while the player is firing their primary. Shown triggering Secondary Enervate while using Phantasma Prime.
rules.build_impact: Dante can run a secondary arcane on Noctua that benefits a primary-focused loadout.

wiki.detail: Wordwarden copies inherit Noctua mods and can trigger arcanes such as Secondary Encumber; Secondary Enervate is not named.

rules.reported: Diriga with Arc Coil equipped can trigger the player's Archon Stretch for extra energy regeneration. The creator lists this among things that shouldn't be able to trigger it.
rules.build_impact: Diriga with Arc Coil feeds energy to frames carrying Archon Stretch, and also helps priming.
rules.creator_caveat: The captions say "Damaged Rakta" and "Arcane Coil"; corrected from the later mention of Diriga and Arc Coil's Diriga compatibility.

wiki.detail: The trigger list includes Diriga with Arc Coil.

rules.reported: With Nourish subsumed plus Combat Discipline, Neutron Star, Archon Vitality and Arcane Avenger, and high strength and range, Null Star particles apply viral priming and start critting after the first kill, killing level 235 Steel Path Grineer. Arcane Arachne and Tenacious Bond further boost it, using wall latches.
rules.build_impact: Null Star can serve as a weaponless damage source when paired with a viral source and these crit sources.

wiki.detail: Particles take flat crit such as Arcane Avenger and need Tenacious Bond since they have a 1x crit multiplier; Nourish adds viral weight and Arachne applies.

rules.reported: With Equilibrium and Energizing Shot, a downed player can shoot an energy orb and revive themselves. It must be an energy orb.
rules.build_impact: This pairing gives a self-revive from orbs on any frame running these mods.

wiki.detail: Energy orbs picked up by shots during bleedout revive you when Equilibrium is equipped.

rules.reported: Enemies caught in Zephyr's tornadoes charge Trumna's alt shot very quickly, and the alt shot also sometimes recharges itself.
rules.build_impact: Zephyr can fire Trumna alt shots almost constantly with little ammo management.

wiki.detail: Tips say kills from a grenade launched into a Tornado generate charges, marked as possibly fixed in Hotfix 37.0.11.

rules.reported: With the Funnel Clouds augment, Vadarya produces a lightning strike after every shot, and sometimes more strikes than it should.
rules.build_impact: Funnel Clouds turns Vadarya into a multi-strike weapon on Zephyr.
rules.creator_caveat: The creator says only "Vadaria"; data.json lists Vadarya Prime.

rules.text_says: Makes enemies you hit vulnerable to finishers.
rules.reported: Sling-Stun instantly and permanently opens enemies to finishers, even with overguard. The creator believes it is the only way to open an overguarded enemy to a finisher, and the finisher also slightly moves the target.
rules.build_impact: Naramon with Sling-Stun supports finisher builds against overguarded targets.
rules.creator_caveat: The focus ability is not in data.json.

wiki.detail: Sling Stun opens any enemy to finishers, including Overguard, permanently, with bonus finisher damage.

rules.reported: Arcane Persistence does work with overguard. Level-cap enemies melted overguard without it, and with it the overguard held on a Dante.
rules.build_impact: Overguard stacking frames can use Arcane Persistence to protect their overguard pool.
rules.creator_caveat: The creator ran the test rather than trust what a Google search said.

rules.reported: Every heavy attack with a dagger, single or dual, opens the enemy to a finisher.
rules.build_impact: Dagger builds can mod finisher damage and use heavy attacks to open targets.
rules.creator_caveat: The creator notes the setup shown isn't modded for finisher damage.

wiki.detail: Any dagger heavy attack opens enemies to finishers; the Finisher page says single daggers and the Dual Daggers page does not list it.

rules.reported: With a reasonable amount of strength, Thurible refills energy each time Railjack missiles are fired, allowing near-unlimited Railjack abilities.
rules.build_impact: Harrow with some strength is a strong choice for sustaining Railjack abilities.

rules.reported: With Prismatic Gem on the field, every instance of Breach Surge damage appears to crit and hits very hard, with a single hit shown at 1.2 million.
rules.build_impact: Combining these two abilities can provide very large Breach Surge damage.
rules.creator_caveat: The creator hedges that it only seems to be every instance.

wiki.detail: Sparks already have 100% crit chance and 1.5x multiplier, capped at 5 million, and Prismatic Gem adds status chance to it.

rules.text_says: Gain 15% ability damage on enemies affected by electricity status.
rules.reported: The status does not have to come from an ability; electricity applied from any source counts, as the text never restricts it.
rules.build_impact: Electricity procs from weapons can turn on the shard's ability damage for a caster build.
rules.creator_caveat: The creator frames this as a common misreading rather than a hidden rule. The captions say "purple" shard.

wiki.detail: Text is simply ability damage on enemies with Electricity status, 15% only for Tauforged and 10% otherwise.

rules.text_says: Enemies damaged spread three spores on death that inflict cold status, and extra shots on infected enemies deal 1.5x damage.
rules.reported: The 1.5x also multiplies damage-over-time ticks, tested against a 44 heat tick on an unmodded weapon. The bonus is also multiplicative with Roar and faction damage mods.
rules.build_impact: Status damage on this weapon scales further than the text suggests, so Roar and faction mods are worth adding.

wiki.detail: The spore 50% vulnerability applies twice to status like a faction mod and is multiplicative with faction mods and other vulnerability sources.

rules.reported: Nova's fourth ability is not affected by range: maximum range barely reached anyone, while heavy duration made the wave travel far. Casting speed affects how fast it expands. The creator says the same applies to Mag's Polarize and Hildryn's Pillage.
rules.build_impact: Mod these abilities for duration, plus cast speed for expansion, rather than range.
rules.creator_caveat: The creator expects this to be old news to many players.

wiki.detail: Wave radius depends on duration only; Polarize radius includes both range and duration, and Pillage has a range-scaled initial radius.

newer_finding.detail: Up to four waves can run at once, so casting every quarter of the wave duration keeps a maximum-size wave out, and a Duration stack needs no Range. It also powers an Evade build through headshots.

source.creator: Brozime
source.title: Nova Prime Breaks Bad the Weird Way | Warframe Recursive Build

rules.reported: Antimatter Absorb with a lot of range imitates Zephyr's Turbulence. As with Turbulence, Butchers can still hurt you.
rules.build_impact: Stacking range on the augment gives Nova protection similar to Turbulence, though not from melee attackers like Butchers.

wiki.detail: Absorb radius scales with range, and Turbulence does not stop melee, matching the Butcher note.

rules.reported: Enemies affected by Spores make melee combo build much faster than normal, compared side by side with a regular build-up. The creator rates Saryn a top melee frame for this.
rules.build_impact: Saryn melee builds should keep Spores up to reach high combo tiers quickly.

wiki.detail: Spores destroyed by melee add to the combo counter.

rules.text_says: The description does not mention terrain punch through.
rules.reported: It has unlimited terrain punch through, shooting through walls, but limited range so you still need to be fairly close.
rules.build_impact: Punch-through mods are unnecessary for terrain on this weapon, but range remains a limit.
rules.creator_caveat: The name could not be matched in data.json.

rules.reported: Health Conversion's armor stacks with Arcane Battery, letting you accumulate a very large energy pool, and the armor itself also helps health tanks.
rules.build_impact: Health-tank builds can pair the two for large energy reserves.

wiki.detail: Gives up to 405 extra max energy with Arcane Battery, but losing a stack drops overflow energy.

rules.reported: Each hit also leaves a bleed damage-over-time worth about 44% of the hit, rising to about 87% on a headshot; measured with all mods removed.
rules.build_impact: Aim Shuriken at heads and count its bleed when judging its damage.

wiki.detail: Bleed deals 43.75% of the hit per tick for 9 ticks; headshots are 3x though it targets center mass.

rules.reported: Shurikens need no line of sight and pass through objects, and they do not break the invisibility from the Shade precept Ghost even though they are coded as weapon damage.
rules.build_impact: Ash can keep throwing Shuriken from behind cover and while invisible through Shade.

wiki.detail: No line of sight needed, bypasses walls, and does not disrupt the Shade cloak.

rules.reported: A full armor strip needs only 143% Ability Strength.
rules.build_impact: Stop adding Strength for the strip once you reach 143%.

wiki.detail: Full armor removal at 143% Strength, or 118% with Corrosive Projection.

rules.reported: While Smoke Screen is active, Blade Storm costs half its energy; Smoke Screen also staggers nearby enemies.
rules.build_impact: Cast Smoke Screen before Blade Storm to halve its cost.

wiki.detail: Any invisibility halves the cost to 6 energy per enemy, and Smoke Screen staggers.

rules.reported: Teleporting onto an enemy marked by Blade Storm lets Ash join his clones and deal damage equal to theirs. The move costs nothing, yet the cast still fails unless you hold enough energy for it.
rules.build_impact: Keep a little energy in reserve so Ash can join a Blade Storm for extra damage.

later_patch.detail: Ash now does cinematic finishers on every marked enemy when joining with Teleport.

wiki.detail: Joining costs 0 energy but enough energy is still needed for Teleport, and Ash is invulnerable during it.

rules.reported: Attack speed mods do affect the shadow clones, but their speed is capped at 1.5 even when the displayed number is higher.
rules.build_impact: Do not invest in attack speed past 1.5 for Blade Storm.

wiki.detail: Clone attack animation speed follows attack speed but is capped at 1.5 and is snapshotted on cast.

rules.reported: Finisher damage mods such as Covert Lethality and Finishing Touch apply to the clones, and clone damage depends directly on the melee combo multiplier, so Blood Rush, Weeping Wounds, combo duration mods and the Gladiator set all work.
rules.build_impact: Build the melee weapon for finisher damage and combo, and hold 12x, to scale Blade Storm.

wiki.detail: Covert Lethality and Finishing Touch raise damage, combo gives up to 12x, and combo-based mods are named as synergies.

rules.reported: Clone kills count as finisher kills, so they trigger finisher-kill arcanes such as Arcane Trickery and Arcane Ultimatum.
rules.build_impact: Arcane Trickery and Arcane Ultimatum are valid on Blade Storm Ash despite no manual finishers.

wiki.detail: Blade Storm is listed as triggering finisher-kill arcanes on both Trickery and Ultimatum pages.

rules.reported: Arcane Fury increases the damage of the shadow clones.
rules.build_impact: Arcane Fury belongs on a melee weapon used with Blade Storm Ash.

wiki.detail: Counts as a melee and finisher strike, so Arcane Fury applies.

rules.reported: Attack speed mods do nothing for Landslide, so Spoiled Strike's attack speed penalty costs nothing here.
rules.build_impact: Use Spoiled Strike on Landslide Fists with no downside.

wiki.detail: Does not benefit from attack speed and Spoiled Strike has no downside.

rules.reported: Landslide can trigger Arcane Reaper.
rules.build_impact: Arcane Reaper works as a survival arcane on Atlas without using a separate melee weapon.

wiki.detail: Can activate from Exalted Weapon melees, and Landslide Fists is a pseudo-exalted that accepts arcanes; Landslide is not named.

rules.reported: Landslide damage, range and energy cost all follow the combo multiplier, improving with each punch and resetting after the third; bullet jumping between punches also extends range.
rules.build_impact: Punch in sets of three and hold 12x combo for the most range, damage and efficiency.

wiki.detail: Combo gives up to 12x damage, each punch widens radius and cuts cost, and bullet jumping extends reach.

rules.reported: Every third punch knocks enemies down, which satisfies Melee Afflictions.
rules.build_impact: Melee Afflictions works on Landslide if you finish the three-punch chain.

wiki.detail: The third hit knocks down and activates Melee Afflictions.

rules.reported: The wall's health comes from Ability Strength plus 500% of Atlas's modded armor, and it is invincible for its first 1 to 4 seconds.
rules.build_impact: Armor mods make Tectonics much more durable.

wiki.detail: Base health plus 500% of armor, multiplied by Strength, and invulnerable for 1 to 4 s by rank.

rules.reported: Rumblers cannot be modded directly; their size, damage, health and armor scale with Atlas's health, Strength, armor and shields.
rules.build_impact: Tank stats on Atlas also make Rumblers bigger and more damaging.

wiki.detail: Melee mods do not apply; size, damage, health and armor follow Strength and health, shield and armor mods.

rules.text_says: The wiki says Arcane Camisado does not raise Rumblers' speed.
rules.reported: Rumblers benefit from Summoner's Wrath and can trigger Arcane Camisado.
rules.build_impact: Run Summoner's Wrath and Arcane Camisado on a Rumbler build.
rules.creator_caveat: The creator is unsure whether the wiki is right about the speed bonus.

wiki.detail: Counted as summons for Summoner's Wrath and Arcane Camisado, but speed multiplier is capped at 1.5.

rules.reported: Sonic Boom ragdolls enemies, which lets a Heat status be applied to each limb independently; the footage does this without Archon Vitality.
rules.build_impact: Pair Sonic Boom with Heat weapons, and Archon Vitality for more, to multiply Heat damage on ragdolled enemies.

later_patch.detail: Sonic Boom no longer ragdolls; it pushes and stuns instead, also adding armor reduction and an Impact proc.

wiki.detail: Page now lists stagger on hit and push force; ragdoll is gone.

rules.text_says: Sonar describes creating weak points.
rules.reported: The highlights are not weak points but damage multipliers, and the multiplier sits on the indicated body part rather than on the highlight itself.
rules.build_impact: Shoot the highlighted body part as a whole, and do not rely on weak-point effects from Sonar.

later_patch.detail: Sonar spots now count as Weak Points, working with weak point mods and arcanes, and show the red reticle.

wiki.detail: Says spots are Weak Points for triggers and that the multiplier applies to the whole body part, but they do not become headcrits.

newer_finding.detail: Since the 44.0 rework Sonar spots do count as weak points: they trigger Evade, Crux, Acuity and Incarnon charging, so the older statement no longer holds for builds.

rules.reported: Several highlights on one body part stack, and the result also stacks with the headshot multiplier; at 200% Strength a highlight gives 10x damage.
rules.build_impact: Recast Sonar to stack highlights, with about 200% Strength as a strong target.

later_patch.detail: Sonar now prefers unmarked body parts, making it harder to stack highlights on one part by recasting.

wiki.detail: Still says highlights on one part stack multiplicatively and with weak point multipliers; 5x at max rank gives 10x at 200% Strength.

newer_finding.detail: Counts the nodes: heads usually have one and other parts two, so at 200% Strength a body part reaches 100x against 60x for a critical head. A non-headshot can be the better target, and the payoff squares with Strength.

rules.text_says: Damage over time is not supposed to be boosted by Sonar.
rules.reported: Gas and Electricity damage over time are boosted anyway, because they can target specific body parts.
rules.build_impact: Favour Gas and Electricity if you want status damage to benefit from Sonar.

wiki.detail: Gas and Electricity AoE DoTs double dip, and all DoTs from a hit on a Sonar spot inherit the boosted damage.

newer_finding.detail: Extends this to Blast's detonation: the hit multiplier sets the proc and the explosion gets Sonar again, about 50,625x in a 15x two-node setup.

rules.reported: Worthy Comradery does not work with Sonar.
rules.build_impact: Do not use Worthy Comradery expecting it to affect Sonar spots.

later_patch.detail: Sonar spots became Weak Points, which gives them synergy with weak point mods and arcanes.

wiki.detail: Notes now say Sonar weak spots count as weak points for this aura.

rules.text_says: The creator calls the description misleading without quoting it.
rules.reported: Silence disables almost every enemy ability, including those of Acolytes, and stops summoning. It also deafens enemies to gunfire, including the caster's, but does not blind them, and everything returns when it ends.
rules.build_impact: Use Silence as near-universal ability denial, but do not expect it to hide you from enemies with line of sight.

wiki.detail: Stops abilities and special attacks, including on bosses and Overguard units without stunning them; deafens enemies and caster, but enemies still detect by sight.

rules.reported: Approaching silenced enemies from behind gives stealth damage multipliers, and kills give bonus XP.
rules.build_impact: Silence can boost stealth damage and speed up weapon levelling.

wiki.detail: Stealth multipliers apply to melee after a short delay while line of sight stays broken; bonus XP not stated.

rules.reported: Silence makes enemies turn on the player's Sentinel for no clear reason.
rules.build_impact: Build the Sentinel to survive when running Silence.

wiki.detail: Tips say enemies target the Sentinel more while Silence runs.

rules.reported: Dodge chance is 100% in a cone based on where Baruuk is facing, not the camera; range mods widen the cone, and at 200% Range he is fully enclosed and immune to bullets. Each dodged bullet erodes Restraint by 1.2%.
rules.build_impact: Aim for 200% Range on Baruuk so Elude covers every angle.

wiki.detail: Facing-based angle, 1.2% erosion and 360 degrees at 200% Range all listed; AoE is not dodged.

rules.reported: Firing interrupts the dodge, but charging a weapon does not.
rules.build_impact: Charge weapons such as the Vaykor Hek keep Elude active while lining up a shot.

wiki.detail: Charging a gun does not count as attacking, but charging a melee heavy does.

rules.reported: Elude doubles the seeking range of the Desolate Hands daggers.
rules.build_impact: Keep Elude up when using daggers to disarm at range.

wiki.detail: Seek range doubled while Elude is active.

rules.reported: Each enemy hit erodes Restraint by 0.8%, but recasting on the same enemies gives no more; negative Duration lets you recast sooner once the timer ends.
rules.build_impact: Negative Duration helps on mobile missions where Lull reaches new enemies.

wiki.detail: 0.8% per enemy and the low-Duration tip are listed; no extra erosion on repeat targets is not stated.

rules.reported: Weapon damage wakes sleeping enemies, but Desolate Hands daggers do not; sleepers take more finisher damage and give bonus XP for stealth kills.
rules.build_impact: Desolate Hands can be used without undoing Lull.

wiki.detail: Daggers do not wake sleepers and finishers get +100%; bonus XP not stated.

rules.reported: Dagger count follows modded Strength, and each dagger gives 10% damage reduction up to 90%; more than nine only makes the 90% last longer.
rules.build_impact: Mod enough Strength for at least nine daggers, and treat further ones as uptime.

wiki.detail: 10% per dagger, capped at 90% at nine daggers.

rules.reported: Restraint erodes 1.6% for each enemy disarmed, not damaged, and already disarmed enemies are not targeted.
rules.build_impact: Use Desolate Hands on fresh, armed enemies when eroding Restraint.

wiki.detail: 1.6% per disarm; disarmed enemies are not targeted until a recast.

rules.reported: Daggers also seek allies and companions, who can carry up to half your dagger count and get damage reduction, but this gives you no erosion.
rules.build_impact: Desolate Hands is also squad protection, though it does not feed Serene Storm that way.

wiki.detail: Sharing and the 50% cap match, but shared daggers disarming enemies do erode Baruuk's Restraint.

rules.reported: Each attack is really two attacks, one from Desert Wind and one from a second weapon, and base damage is highest on slide and wall attacks; enemies within 3 m are also slowed.
rules.build_impact: Favour slide and wall attacks in Serene Storm.
rules.creator_caveat: The second weapon appears in captions as Wind Waves and is not in the item data.

later_patch.detail: Script error fix for Serene Storm only.

wiki.detail: Wind waves are a separate damage entity, slide and wall attacks hit hardest, 3 m slow.

rules.reported: Steel Charge and Arcane Fury boost Serene Storm; every third attack knocks down, which satisfies Melee Afflictions; damage also follows the combo counter.
rules.build_impact: Treat Serene Storm like a melee weapon build, with combo mods and these melee buffs.

wiki.detail: Steel Charge and Arcane Fury apply and attacks add combo; third-hit knockdown not stated; radial slam damage ignores combo.

rules.reported: Serene Storm can be activated with only 4% Restraint eroded, grants up to 40% damage reduction with Strength, and Restraint can still be eroded while it runs.
rules.build_impact: Keep casting the first three abilities during Serene Storm to extend it.

wiki.detail: Usable at 96% Restraint, 40% DR cap, erosion continues; DR only while Desert Wind is the active weapon.

rules.reported: Each enemy hit is staggered and gets a Tau status, and Caliban leeches health, shields and a quarter of the energy cost; negative Efficiency therefore raises the energy returned.
rules.build_impact: Negative Efficiency has less downside on Razor Gyre because more energy returns per hit.

wiki.detail: Refund is a quarter of cost and scales inversely with Efficiency; Tau is a 25% chance per tick, not guaranteed.

rules.reported: With Razor Mortar, the Ortholysts can trigger Archon Stretch.
rules.build_impact: Archon Stretch can sustain energy on Caliban through his summons if Razor Mortar is equipped.

wiki.detail: Razor Mortar adds Electricity, and a 39.1 fix made it trigger Archon Stretch, before this video.

rules.reported: The 35% base vulnerability is multiplied by Strength, passing 100% at 300%, and it also boosts summons and Fusion Strike; recasting refreshes both lift and vulnerability.
rules.build_impact: Strength on Caliban raises the vulnerability that all his damage benefits from.
rules.creator_caveat: The creator thinks its single Tau status is too low.

wiki.detail: 35% at rank 3, Strength scaling, boosts Lethal Progeny and Fusion Strike; recast refreshes; no cap stated.

rules.reported: It needs line of sight, and although it does not lift Overguarded enemies, it still applies vulnerability to them.
rules.build_impact: Cast it at Overguarded targets for the vulnerability, and keep line of sight.

wiki.detail: Line of sight needed; Overguard blocks the lift only.

rules.reported: Summon level is Caliban's level times his Strength and has nothing to do with enemy level; Strength also sets their health, damage multiplier and shield restore rate.
rules.build_impact: Strength is the key stat for Caliban's summons.

wiki.detail: Rank is Caliban rank times Strength; Strength also sets damage, health and shield restore.

rules.reported: Conculysts deal Slash and Tau but can apply only Slash status at 20%. Fusion Strike gives a 3% chance to send them into a rage with lasers, whose damage ignores your multiplier, and they also cast their own Fusion Strike whenever you do.
rules.build_impact: Do not count on Conculyst lasers scaling, and do not pick Conculysts for Tau priming.

wiki.detail: 3% laser chance, lasers and tornado outside the multiplier, 20% Slash on tornado, mini Fusion Strikes at 0.5x.

rules.reported: Ortholyst direct hits and AoE have 100% Tau status, rising to 300% in turret mode.
rules.build_impact: Ortholysts are the Tau priming choice among the summons.

wiki.detail: 100% on cannons and mortar, 300% only on the mortar's split seekers.

rules.reported: The Symbilyst immediately summons six small minions that restore shields to you, companions and allies and draw aggro as high-threat targets, and it replaces any that die; its attacks are weak, with at best 20% status.
rules.build_impact: Use this summon for support and aggro, not damage.
rules.creator_caveat: The summon type appears in captions as Simulist and its minions as Chlorolists.

wiki.detail: Six replaceable minions, high threat, 10-20% status; the wiki names them Summulyst and Choralyst.

rules.reported: It hits on contact and again on explosion, has infinite body punch through, and strips armor and shields permanently; 200% Strength gives a full armor strip in one cast.
rules.build_impact: 200% Strength is enough for Caliban to fully strip armor with a single cast.

wiki.detail: 200% full strip, once per cast; shield strip is of current maximum, so it has diminishing returns.

rules.reported: Summons benefit from Summoner's Wrath, trigger Arcane Camisado, and are boosted by weapon-damage buffs such as Roar and Xata's Whisper, and even by Shock Trooper.
rules.build_impact: Squad weapon buffs and summon buffs both raise Caliban's summon damage.

wiki.detail: Summoner's Wrath and Camisado listed; Roar must be cast near them, Shock Trooper misses several attacks; Xata's Whisper not stated.

rules.reported: Damage has a very steep falloff with range, it passes through objects, and casting speed including yellow Archon shards speeds its animation; weapons cannot be fired during it, but melee and other abilities can be used.
rules.build_impact: Do not build Range for Scream damage; Range matters only for buffing allies.

wiki.detail: States damage does not decrease with distance; it passes obstacles, is sped by Casting Speed, and melee and abilities stay usable.

rules.reported: The Heat aura has 10% status, its health bonus adds to mods rather than multiplying, and the effect passes through objects.
rules.build_impact: Do not expect the Heat Ward health bonus to multiply with mods.

wiki.detail: 10% status at rank 3, additive Health, passes obstacles.

rules.reported: The Electricity Ward turns incoming damage into arcs with 25% status.
rules.build_impact: Electricity Ward gives some reactive status output as well as shields.

later_patch.detail: Fixed client Chromas always getting the Heat Ward whatever the emissive tint.

wiki.detail: Arcs have 25% status at rank 3 and scale with Strength.

rules.reported: The weapon damage from Toxin requires holstering for at least 3 seconds, and modded Duration then sets how long it lasts. It also has up to a 50% chance per second to deal 5% of an enemy's max health as Toxin, with status chance set by Strength.
rules.build_impact: Holster before fights when using Toxin Ward for weapon damage, and consider Duration.

later_patch.detail: Fixed client Chromas always getting the Heat Ward whatever the emissive tint.

wiki.detail: Lists a 3 s Duration-scaled holster buff, which reads as buff length rather than a 3 s holster requirement; poison roll is every 2 s in text, per second in the infobox.

rules.reported: The armor from Cold Ward is additive with mods, not multiplicative.
rules.build_impact: Do not stack armor mods expecting a multiplicative gain from Cold Ward.

later_patch.detail: Fixed client Chromas always getting the Heat Ward whatever the emissive tint.

wiki.detail: Armor bonus is additive with mods; Strength does multiply the Ward value.

rules.reported: The Cold damage reflected at enemies is coded as melee damage, and with Dual Ichor in Incarnon mode it can trigger the weapon's toxic clouds; Melee Influence is named as interacting too.
rules.build_impact: Reflected Cold can trigger melee-damage effects without swinging.

later_patch.detail: Fixed client Chromas always getting the Heat Ward whatever the emissive tint.

wiki.detail: Reflected projectiles count as unattributed damage, naming Melee Influence and Dual Ichor clouds.

rules.reported: Scorn can be maxed by shield damage or 24 melee kills, and Fury by health damage or 19 ranged kills; the damage required depends on modded Strength.
rules.build_impact: Vex Armor can be maxed through kills, so you need not soak damage.

wiki.detail: 24 melee or 19 ranged kills listed; thresholds are Strength-scaled.

rules.reported: Effigy is boosted by Summoner's Wrath and can trigger Arcane Camisado; it uses a scream attack within 20 m and a wing attack within 5 m, and its element follows your selection.
rules.build_impact: Effigy can benefit from summon-based mods and arcanes.
rules.creator_caveat: The wiki lists its status chance as unknown.

wiki.detail: Summon status, Wrath and Camisado, 5 m wing flap match; 20 m is the stream range, and the scream stun reaches 30 m.

rules.reported: The chance of double credits depends on how close the enemy dies to Effigy. It stacks with Secura Lecta for four times the credits, and also works on Techrot safes and the Profit-Taker, though it reportedly must sit right at the Profit-Taker's foot.
rules.build_impact: Pair Effigy with Secura Lecta for credit farming, and place it close to the target.
rules.creator_caveat: The Profit-Taker placement detail is hearsay.

later_patch.detail: Secura Lecta bonus now also triggers on DoT kills from it when unequipped, and no longer triggers several times per enemy; Effigy stacking not addressed.

wiki.detail: Extra-credit chance is flat by rank on sentry kills; the 10 m bonus depends on where credits are picked up, not where the enemy dies.

rules.reported: Scenario: Vex Armor's armor feeds Arcane Battery for a huge energy pool, Guardian Armor all but removes the need to recast Vex Armor, Arcane Persistence limits health damage, and Quick Thinking drains energy instead of letting lethal damage kill you; Hunter Adrenaline is also part of the setup. The creator reports not dying as long as kills continue.
rules.build_impact: Health tanks can use a large energy pool as their second health bar through this interaction.
rules.creator_caveat: The interaction is credited to Tactical Potato; Arcane Persistence had a known bug according to another video.

wiki.detail: Energy buffer confirmed and Arcane Battery suggested; damage under Quick Thinking feeds neither Hunter Adrenaline nor Vex Armor.

rules.reported: It guarantees Slash and Puncture status. Strength above 100% drop chance guarantees one orb with a chance of a second, recasting extends the drop window, and being inside Prismatic Gem's aura extends all its effects.
rules.build_impact: Mod Strength past 100% for guaranteed orbs and use Fractured Blast near the gem.
rules.creator_caveat: Captions say Saryn throughout, but the video is about Citrine.

wiki.detail: Guaranteed statuses are Impact and Slash, not Puncture; over-100% orbs, recast window and Gem extension all match.

rules.reported: Kills and assists both raise damage reduction to 90%, and it decays faster the higher it is; Strength raises both the start value and the gain, and allies but not companions receive it.
rules.build_impact: Keep assists coming, for example through status or the companion, to hold high damage reduction.

later_patch.detail: Preserving Shell now also applies to Companions.

wiki.detail: Now lists Companions as receiving personal arrays; the rest of the claim matches.

rules.reported: Damage reduction stacks multiplicatively across multiple Citrines, probably still capped at 90%.
rules.build_impact: Extra Citrines help reach the cap faster, but likely do not exceed it.
rules.creator_caveat: The creator is only guessing about the cap.

wiki.detail: Multiple Citrines stack multiplicatively; 90% is a general cap, with no separate multi-Citrine wording.

rules.reported: Its status chance and status duration only add to your weapon's mods; the status duration buff is not displayed.
rules.build_impact: Value Gem status additively with mods, and remember that its status duration is invisible.

wiki.detail: Both bonuses are additive with mods, and status duration is hidden.

rules.reported: Walking into a Nullifier bubble does not destroy it, but a bubble touching the gem does; falling off the map also destroys it.
rules.build_impact: Place the gem clear of Nullifier bubbles.

wiki.detail: Gem dies when it enters a nullification zone or when Citrine falls out of bounds, not when she enters one.

rules.reported: The gem fires one beam per shot per ally within its radius, and companions count; it needs no line of sight, follows rapid fire with rapid beams and focuses on enemies damaged by allies.
rules.build_impact: High fire rate and allies or companions in range raise beam output.
rules.creator_caveat: The creator says this was hard to demonstrate.

wiki.detail: Companions count and no line of sight is needed, but each ally has a 0.4 s delay between beams.

rules.text_says: The wiki claims unlimited beam range.
rules.reported: The creator could not prove this: beam animations stop for distant enemies, but the effect was clearly still working at about 100 m.
rules.build_impact: You can stand far from your target within about 100 m and still get beams.
rules.creator_caveat: Beyond 100 m is unconfirmed.

wiki.detail: Lists unrestricted beam range.

rules.reported: Beams apply Heat, Cold, Toxin and Electricity, so they feed Condition Overload-type mods, Archon mods and arcanes that need specific status effects.
rules.build_impact: Pair the gem with Condition Overload and status-dependent Archon mods and arcanes.

wiki.detail: Four elemental procs per beam; tips name Condition Overload and Archon mods.

rules.reported: The creator rates the Mecha set as the best synergy with the gem, shown with a Sentinel and described as absurd.
rules.build_impact: Consider the Mecha set on Citrine's companion.

rules.reported: The companion and gem together keep kills and assists flowing, enough to sustain Preserving Shell with no kills from the player.
rules.build_impact: Prismatic Companion on a four-legged companion lets Citrine hold damage reduction hands-free.

wiki.detail: Free-moving companions carry the gem, not Sentinels or larval Vulpaphylas; Gem contributes kills and assists.

rules.reported: Enemies with Blast status trigger many extra beams, for no known reason.
rules.build_impact: Adding Blast to the weapon can multiply beam output.
rules.creator_caveat: Creator has no explanation for this.

wiki.detail: Tips document Blast status triggering extra beams, including 5 m around a 10-stack detonation.

rules.reported: It is a 190-degree cone, and looking straight down turns it into a 360-degree wave. It only affects enemies you are looking at when you land, and crystals grow diagonally, giving a target on spinning shield Eximus.
rules.build_impact: Look straight down to cast it all around you.

wiki.detail: 190 degree cone, 360 degrees looking straight down or up, sight check at landing, Guardian Eximus tip.

rules.reported: Crystals give a flat 300% critical chance to weapons, but the critical damage doubling applies only to hitscan weapons; bows do not get it, and only the Vigilante set can raise the crit damage buff.
rules.build_impact: Pick hitscan weapons for Crystallize crit damage, and use the Vigilante set if you want more.

wiki.detail: 300% absolute crit; x2 for hitscan only, also excluding continuous; Vigilante reaches a Tier-4 hit.

rules.reported: Placing it gives weapons 10 m of body punch through and infinite terrain punch through, including secondaries and melee, not just the ranged attacks of melee weapons; three can be active at a time and they are indestructible.
rules.build_impact: Seek lets every weapon type shoot through walls, reducing the need for punch-through mods.
rules.creator_caveat: Captions call the frame Saryn Prime and Cedo 9, but the video is about Cyte-09.

later_patch.detail: Only fixed a performance issue with punch through and fire rate.

wiki.detail: 10 m body and infinite terrain punch through, melee included, three invulnerable antennae.

rules.reported: The weak point damage increase stacks additively with Primary Acuity and Primary Deadhead, which the creator still rates as worthwhile.
rules.build_impact: Expect diminished, but still useful, returns from those arcanes.

later_patch.detail: Primary and Secondary Deadhead triggers changed from headshot to weak point.

wiki.detail: Seek adds with Primary Acuity in the weak point formula, but Deadhead appears as a separate multiplier.

rules.reported: Range sets how far away enemies can be detected and highlighted.
rules.build_impact: Mod Range on Cyte-09 for Seek detection.

wiki.detail: Range sets the 45-60 m scan distance.

rules.reported: Reloaded weapons get a damage buff set by modded Strength and doubled for sniper weapons, and it is calculated from the player who picks up the pack, not the one who dropped it.
rules.build_impact: Your own Strength decides how well you benefit from another Cyte-09's packs, and snipers benefit most.

later_patch.detail: Fixed pack bonus damage not being affected by Ability Strength when picked up from the ground.

wiki.detail: States allies use the dropping Cyte-09's percentage, not the picker's; doubled sniper value matches.

rules.reported: The pack adds a separate damage instance with one guaranteed status per shot, and this extra instance also works with the Kuva Sobek and Acid Shells.
rules.build_impact: Resupply can trigger on-status or on-hit effects such as Acid Shells.

later_patch.detail: Elemental ammo status no longer retriggers death explosions recursively, and Acid Shells radius fell from 15 m to 10 m; the bonus damage and status remain.

wiki.detail: Explosions still trigger extra-hit effects; patch history records the 44.1.3 change.

rules.reported: Its element does not combine with weapon elements: toxin from one source and electricity from another stayed separate instead of forming Corrosive.
rules.build_impact: Choose pack elements for their own status, not for combining with mods.

wiki.detail: Main and extra hit have separate procs, so modded Heat plus forced Electricity gives no Radiation.

rules.reported: Packs and their buffs do not apply to Arch-guns.
rules.build_impact: Do not plan Resupply around Arch-guns.

wiki.detail: Arch-guns and battery weapons do not benefit.

rules.reported: The guaranteed status does not apply if the shot kills in one hit.
rules.build_impact: Do not rely on Resupply elements for crowd control when you one-shot everything.

wiki.detail: Forced status does not apply on a one-bullet kill.

rules.reported: Packs do not override Oraxia's Silken Stride damage type but do reload her weapons. Uriel can take a pack's element, but his Heat bonus returns when he reloads.
rules.build_impact: Do not count on Resupply to change element on these two frames.

wiki.detail: Silken Stride keeps priority; Demonium and Resupply override each other, and Heat returns on reload.

rules.reported: Invisibility also covers your companion. A hidden cooldown begins at cast, so if weak point kills extend the duration past the cooldown, you can recast immediately on expiry.
rules.build_impact: Keep getting weak point kills to avoid downtime altogether.

later_patch.detail: Only fixed extension when Evade is subsumed over Doom with Spectral Spirit.

wiki.detail: Companion included; cooldown starts on cast and can be outlasted.

rules.reported: Strength affects only the health restored per weak point kill, while Duration affects initial duration, maximum duration and time recovered per kill.
rules.build_impact: Mod Duration, not Strength, for Evade uptime.

wiki.detail: Strength sets health restored; Duration sets base, extension and cap.

rules.reported: Its damage multiplier and ricochet distance come from the mods on Cyte-09, and the multiplier stacks additively with Serration and Galvanized Aptitude; casting also staggers enemies within 10 m.
rules.build_impact: Treat added Strength as additive base damage on Neutralizer.

wiki.detail: Multiplier is additive with Serration and Galvanized Aptitude; 10 m ricochet and stagger.

rules.reported: Ricochets are fixed at four, though multishot and punch through may theoretically add more; critical damage grows as you zoom, and zooming is required to build and keep combo.
rules.build_impact: Fire Neutralizer zoomed in, to get crit damage and combo.
rules.creator_caveat: The multishot and punch through increase is theoretical.

wiki.detail: Four ricochets and rising zoom crit are listed; zoom-gated combo and the multishot theory are not.

rules.reported: Alternate fire applies 10 Cold stacks despite showing 0% status chance.
rules.build_impact: Use alternate fire as Cold priming regardless of status mods.

wiki.detail: Alt fire has 0% status and inflicts 10 Cold stacks.

rules.reported: Being an ability, it can trigger Archon Flow, and standard shots can too if Cold is modded onto it.
rules.build_impact: Archon Flow is an option on Neutralizer builds.

wiki.detail: Tips recommend Archon Flow with Cold from mods or Resupply on Neutralizer.

rules.reported: It can trigger and benefit from Arcane Rage, and from the Dead Eye aura, though only additively.
rules.build_impact: Weapon arcanes and auras are options, but expect additive gains.

wiki.detail: Dead Eye and Arcane Rage are listed as applying; additive stacking is not stated.

rules.reported: Viral status is guaranteed, the Scythes also damage enemies while circling you, and maximum slow of 95% is reached at 272% Strength.
rules.build_impact: Aim for 272% Strength for the full slow.

wiki.detail: Viral per sickle, spin damage, 95% slow at 272% Strength.

rules.reported: They track in a cone from the camera and supposedly never fire backwards, yet the creator shows them doing so; they track enemies within 40 m and can fly 120 m, with infinite body punch through but no terrain punch through.
rules.build_impact: Do not rely on Scythes passing through walls, and expect some inconsistency in targeting.
rules.creator_caveat: The creator cannot explain the backward firing.

wiki.detail: 40 m and 120 m match and it says sickles do not target behind Dagath; the creator's backward shots are unexplained.

rules.reported: Hitting a doomed enemy spreads Doom, and recorded Doom damage can boost Scythe damage, but only for one of the seven Scythes per cast.
rules.build_impact: Use Scythes to spread Doom, not for their supercharged damage.

wiki.detail: Spreading Doom and triggering Phantom Wrath are listed; the one-of-seven limit is not.

rules.reported: The cone is 40 degrees, and Range mods do not widen it.
rules.build_impact: Do not mod Range to widen Doom.

wiki.detail: Fixed 40 degree cone; Range is listed only for cone length.

rules.reported: It records damage for 2 seconds, then revisits a percentage as true damage, capped at 100% at 286% Strength. Each enemy can have one sickle, and recorded damage belongs only to the enemy it was dealt to.
rules.build_impact: Target 286% Strength and deal burst damage to each enemy within the 2-second window.

wiki.detail: 2 s window, 100% cap at 286%, one sickle per enemy, no sharing, true damage.

rules.reported: Dooming an enemy while Grave Spirit is active doubles Doom's potency unless it is already at the cap.
rules.build_impact: With Grave Spirit active you can reach the cap with less Strength.

wiki.detail: Grave Spirit doubles stored damage; Spectral Spirit removes this synergy.

rules.reported: Rakhali's Cavalry on doomed enemies permanently strips their armor and shields, and a full strip requires 286% Strength.
rules.build_impact: 286% Strength doubles as the threshold for a full strip.

wiki.detail: 286% only applies to one hit; strip repeats per Kaithe hit, so 143% fully strips after two hits.

rules.reported: Doom can steal kills from your weapons and companions, making Galvanized mods harder to trigger, and companion on-kill effects such as Contagious Bond likewise.
rules.build_impact: Be careful combining Doom with weapon or companion kill-stacking effects.

wiki.detail: Lists stolen weapon kills, including Galvanized mods, and Contagious Bond.

rules.reported: Its critical damage bonus is doubled on doomed enemies, but only additive with mods like Vital Sense; you lose it if you fall off the map or enter a nullifier bubble.
rules.build_impact: Doom enemies first to get its full value.

wiki.detail: Additive with Vital Sense, doubled on Doomed foes, lost out of bounds or in a Nullifier bubble.

rules.reported: Dying under Grave Spirit gives an invulnerable spectral form with 100% dodge, and kills in that form always drop a health orb; shields do not recharge, unless using Brief Respite or Augur mods. The orbs feed Health Conversion, Equilibrium, Arcane Pulse and Arcane Blessing.
rules.build_impact: Build orb-triggered effects on Dagath and restore shields through Augur or Brief Respite.

wiki.detail: Spectral form, 100% dodge, orb drops, shield rule and orb synergies all listed.

rules.reported: Building into Arcane Escapist can make Dagath invulnerable indefinitely.
rules.build_impact: Arcane Escapist is a candidate for permanent invulnerability on Dagath.

wiki.detail: Nine stacks of rank 4 Escapist cover the cooldown; stacks come from Mercy kills.

rules.reported: Dagath is invincible during the cast, so casting speed shortens that safe window.
rules.build_impact: Casting speed trades away invulnerability time on this ability.

wiki.detail: 1.5 s invulnerability scales down with casting speed.

rules.reported: The Kavats deal continuous damage while touching enemies, so casting exactly 5 m ahead of a target often kills it before the animation ends; they ignore walls and can be recast to redirect.
rules.build_impact: Cast it at about 5 m and use recasts to steer it.

wiki.detail: Summoned 5 m ahead, contact damage in the animation, phases walls, recast redirects; the wiki calls them Kaithes.

rules.reported: With the augment that spreads Doom through weapons, Grave Spirit must be monitored and recast, unlike normal cast-and-forget use.
rules.build_impact: Plan for recasts when you run Spectral Spirit.
rules.creator_caveat: The creator does not name the augment; the name comes from the item data.

wiki.detail: Enters spectral form at once and can be dispelled into cooldown; crit only in that form, and the Doom doubling is lost.

rules.text_says: Slam range depends on the height the slam starts from since a recent change.
rules.reported: Slams forced by a melee stance always use full range and full AoE damage regardless of height, so you need not bullet jump; Vinquibus heavy attacks and Sparring weapons such as Hirudo and Obex do this.
rules.build_impact: Use forced-slam stances to spam full-range slams from the ground.
rules.creator_caveat: The creator says this is not widely discussed and followed a nerf a few months earlier.

later_patch.detail: Predates the video: fixed Sparring and Talon heavies borrowing the previous slam's range, setting a fixed range.

wiki.detail: Update 39 made slam radius scale with height; an earlier slam rework excluded stance-combo slams, and Sparring heavies have a set range since 40.

rules.reported: The exalted melee of Valkyr and Baruuk use the Sparring stance, so they can spam forced full-range slams, reaching billions of damage in an 8 m area.
rules.build_impact: Build Hysteria or Serene Storm for slam damage rather than ordinary swings.

wiki.detail: Each uses its own exclusive stance, and Hysteria lists a 5 m slam while Serene Storm lists 8 m; Serene Storm radial slam has no crit or combo scaling.

rules.reported: Valkyr's passive of up to 300% melee damage is additive with sources such as Pressure Point.
rules.build_impact: Her passive overlaps with base damage mods, so it reduces their relative value.

wiki.detail: Rage bonus is additive with Pressure Point and Condition Overload.

rules.reported: Every slam counts toward the Rage meter, so it stays practically at 300% and keeps her death gate ready at higher levels.
rules.build_impact: Slam spam keeps her passive damage and death protection active with no extra setup.

wiki.detail: 3% per melee hit and 12% per kill; death prevention needs 150% and consumes all Rage.

rules.reported: Subsumed onto Valkyr, it grants full invulnerability during the cast and heavy attack animation, teleports you to the targeted enemy, and additively raises melee crit chance with Strength, reaching tier 5 crits.
rules.build_impact: Subsume Wrathful Advance over Valkyr's first or third ability for safe slam spam.
rules.creator_caveat: Captions name Khora as the source, but the item data lists the ability under Kullervo.

later_patch.detail: Only fixed stutter and failed casts when another animation interrupts it.

wiki.detail: Teleport, heavy and final crit match; invulnerability is during wind up, and subsumed crit is halved to 25-100%.

rules.reported: Each cast refreshes Melee Exposure's stacks, which keeps up +240% Corrosive on every slam.
rules.build_impact: Melee Exposure pairs with spammed casts for constant Corrosive on slams.

wiki.detail: 240% limit, stacks share a refreshed 25 s timer, works on Valkyr Talons and Desert Wind.

rules.reported: Heavy attacks constantly reset combo, so Initial Combo is very strong: it multiplies slam damage and instantly restores the combo after one heavy, without normal melee attacks.
rules.build_impact: Stack Initial Combo through Ready Steel, Galvanized Reflex and Corrupt Charge on heavy-slam builds.

wiki.detail: Heavies consume combo and initial combo restores it, but at 40 points per second rather than instantly.

rules.reported: Primary Debilitate lets combined elements split further into their base elements, so a Bubonico with Viral, Corrosive, Heat and Magnetic also adds Cold, Electricity and Toxin; Secondary Encumber offers a similar all-elements route.
rules.build_impact: These arcanes help a priming weapon apply far more status types for Condition Overload.

later_patch.detail: Only a script error fix for Primary Debilitate.

wiki.detail: Extra base-element statuses need a combined status at 10 stacks; Secondary Encumber is secondary-only, random, and limited to one proc per instant.

newer_finding.detail: Newer uses: on Sevagoth, procs fire from Claws and count for the weapon holding the arcane; on Banshee they double dip on Sonar (KeesieOilcorner, 2026-11-01).

source.creator: TGHerolix
source.title: Warframe | Totally my Last Time Talking about Sevagoth

rules.reported: Spores from the Vulpaphyla Quills mod count as melee attacks, so Tandem Bond can build up to 12x combo, Pack Leader keeps giving Overguard on melee attacks, and the spores passively prime Viral for up to 4.25x damage.
rules.build_impact: A Panzer Vulpaphyla gives combo and priming with no input from the player.

wiki.detail: Each popped Viral Quills spore counts as a companion melee hit; 10 spores give 66 combo.

rules.reported: Its Seismic Impact perk makes the next four slams copy the damage wave. The copy scales with enemy level, bypasses attenuation from enemies such as Acolytes, and can kill Thrax ghost forms.
rules.build_impact: Keep Seismic Impact charges ready for attenuated enemies and Thrax.

Once a companion with Contagious Bond starts killing them, the Heat spreads through the group. A fast melee with attack speed and Discipline's Merit gives a Tennokai opening every four hits.

rules.reported: Explosions from AoE weapons can't land headshots or gain the headshot crit multiplier, even when the projectile physically strikes the head.
rules.build_impact: Only the blast is excluded. Headshot mods and arcanes still do something for a direct arrow hit on these weapons, but not for the splash.

wiki.detail: Radial parts do get a 1x multiplier and can't trigger headshot conditions, but this doesn't apply to the projectile itself, naming Kuva Bramma's arrows.

rules.reported: High starting crit is largely wasted with Secondary Enervate because big crits reset it. On a Kuva Nukor with Avenger, adding Arcane Hot Shot raised average crit chance only from about 135% to 146%.
rules.build_impact: Use that second arcane slot for fire rate, ammo or damage instead. Don't stack base crit on low crit weapons running Enervate.

wiki.detail: Its average crit formula gives 102.45 + 0.5x below 110% modded crit, so each added point is worth half. Fixes through 44.1.2 only stop infinite stacking from specific sources.

rules.reported: Null Star and Jade Stars take universal weapon bonuses. Flat crit such as Avenger or Covenant makes them crit, while percentage crit such as Hot Shot does nothing for them. They also need a crit damage source such as Crepuscular or Tenacious Bond before those crits add damage.
rules.build_impact: To scale these subsumed abilities, pair flat crit with a final crit damage source. Don't count on percentage crit mods or arcanes.

wiki.detail: Both have 0% crit and a 1x multiplier, requiring flat crit and sources like Crepuscular or Tenacious Bond. Hot Shot is listed as modded crit, which has nothing to work on at 0% base.

rules.reported: Weapon-coded abilities including Jade Stars can have their damage multiplied by Arcane Arachne, multiplying with Ability Strength.
rules.build_impact: Arachne is worth using for Null Star but does nothing for Jade Stars.

wiki.detail: Motes are not affected by base damage bonuses like Arcane Arachne or Vigorous Swap. Null Star does benefit from them.

rules.reported: Fireball counts as weapon damage in code, so direct hits gain headshot multipliers and it benefits from Arcane Arachne. Range mods greatly enlarge its blast.
rules.build_impact: Aim Fireball at heads. The creator considers Arachne a wasted slot here even though it works.

wiki.detail: Direct hits can headshot and Arachne applies. The wiki differs on one detail: only the AoE procs Heat, not the direct hit as the creator says.

rules.text_says: Combo damage multiplier up to 8x.
rules.reported: Fireball's real multiplier is one higher than the combo number shown, and the combo limit rises with heat, reaching a shown 12x and an actual 13x at full heat.
rules.build_impact: Fireball damage peaks only at full heat, so its best moment comes right as Immolation starts draining energy.

wiki.detail: Combo counts extra damage, so the true multiplier is one more, and full heat gives 6x, 7x, 9x and 13x. Casts that miss still build combo.

rules.reported: Immolation's 90% damage reduction caps at 125% Ability Strength, and Ember's passive gives 5% Strength per burning enemy, so she may not need any Strength mods for survival.
rules.build_impact: Spend mod slots on Range or other stats and let burning enemies cover the Strength for damage reduction.

wiki.detail: Confirms the 125% figure for the 50-90% range, and a tip says 105.8% is enough at full heat. The passive counts burning enemies in Affinity Range.

rules.reported: At full heat, energy drain grows until the 30 second mark, where it reaches its fastest rate.
rules.build_impact: Don't sit at full heat expecting the drain to level off. Fire Blast to dump heat before it becomes costly.

wiki.detail: Drain grows by 0.4 energy per second every second and is stated to be uncapped; 12 per second at 30 seconds is only an example.

rules.reported: Fire Blast's armor strip is set by current heat, so a full strip in one cast needs full heat and extra Strength won't help. Casting it also lowers heat without ending Immolation, and the Healing Flame augment's healing and overguard scale with heat too.
rules.build_impact: Open with Fire Blast at full heat. Its strip and its heat dump happen together, which makes it the natural release once the meter fills.

wiki.detail: Reduction runs 50-100% with heat, capped at 100% Strength, so only lower Strength changes it. It removes 50% heat, and the strip is permanent.

rules.text_says: Costs energy per enemy.
rules.reported: Inferno costs 10 energy per enemy, up to 10 enemies, and costs nothing if it hits none, which makes it a free way to build heat. It needs no line of sight, only enemies on screen and in modded range.
rules.build_impact: Cast it before a fight to raise heat for free, and add Range rather than worry about cost in big rooms.

wiki.detail: All confirmed. It also hits every target past 10 for no extra energy, within a 67.5 degree cone, and an off-screen enemy with line of sight won't be hit.

rules.reported: More Ability Duration makes Inferno's rings of fire last longer but expand much more slowly. Each enemy the ring spreads to starts its own timer, so negative duration can give better crowd control through fast expansion.
rules.build_impact: Consider negative Duration on Ember even for Inferno. Duration here is a trade rather than a straight upgrade.
rules.creator_caveat: Negative duration is the creator's personal preference.

wiki.detail: Growth is inversely affected by Duration, and newly affected enemies get a fresh ring duration.

rules.reported: Rings of fire gain bonus damage equal to current heat, so 85% heat gives an 85% bonus.
rules.build_impact: Cast Inferno for damage after heat is high and before Fire Blast dumps it.

wiki.detail: Confirms up to +100% and adds that it is locked in at cast and doesn't follow later heat changes.

rules.reported: A direct hit gives 10 Cold procs and the blast gives 6. Range enlarges the blast but can't give it the 10 procs. Frost's passive doubles how long Cold procs last.
rules.build_impact: Land the direct hit to freeze a priority target outright. Range only spreads the weaker slow.

wiki.detail: Lists 10 and 6 procs, and the passive page gives +100% Cold duration on Frost's abilities. 44.0 and 44.1 changed nothing here.

rules.reported: Arbitration drones can't thaw enemies you've frozen, so they stay controlled even while protected.
rules.build_impact: Frost keeps his crowd control in Arbitrations.

wiki.detail: Tips on Freeze and Avalanche say shield drones can't thaw frozen enemies, though they can still protect them.

rules.reported: Ice Wave always applies exactly six Cold procs, which Strength can't raise. Range widens the cone only up to 60 degrees. It ignores obstacles and elevation changes.
rules.build_impact: Neither stat turns Ice Wave into a full freeze, and range past the 60 degree angle only adds length.

wiki.detail: Lists 6 procs and the 60 degree cap and says it follows terrain.

rules.reported: During its first 4 seconds the globe can't be hurt and adds enemy damage taken to its health. Casting a new globe on an old one moves all that health over, up to 1 million. Only enemy damage counts.
rules.build_impact: On a defense objective, keep recasting in place. Armor and Strength set the starting health, but absorbed damage is what makes it huge.

wiki.detail: Confirms absorption, combining health, the 1,000,000 cap, and no gain from allied fire. Stacked globes don't count toward the limit of 4. 44.0's Cold Front augment changes behaviour only if equipped.

rules.reported: Enemies pushed out by a new globe take up to 50% of their maximum health as true damage if they hit a wall, which is real damage at high levels. A Nullifier bubble doesn't pop a globe outright; it wears it down gradually.
rules.build_impact: Casting globes with enemies against a wall is a percent-based damage tool, with no Strength needed.

wiki.detail: Says obstacles can deal up to 50% maximum health as True damage. Nullifier bubbles drain 20% health per second and stop damage conversion, since update 40.

rules.reported: Avalanche fully strips armor in one cast at 167% Ability Strength, and needs no line of sight.
rules.build_impact: Aim for 167% Strength on Frost for full strip, less with an ally's Corrosive Projection.

wiki.detail: Confirms 167%, or 137% with one Corrosive Projection, and that it hits through walls.

rules.reported: Enemies that die while frozen by Avalanche explode for Cold damage around them, so Duration has a damage reason as well as crowd control.
rules.build_impact: Longer Duration keeps more enemies frozen at the moment they die, which spreads more explosions.

wiki.detail: Lists shatter damage on frozen enemies, with 100% falloff over its radius, ignoring obstacles.

rules.reported: Avalanche's animation speed caps at 50% casting speed, reached with one Tauforged and one regular casting speed shard.
rules.build_impact: Stop at that amount on Frost. Further casting speed shards are better spent on another stat.

wiki.detail: Tips confirm the 50% cap, listing Natural Talent, two Amber shards or Power Transfer as ways to reach it.

rules.reported: Subsuming Parasitic Armor and casting it before Icy Avalanche raised the overguard from 3,850 to 28,440 in the creator's test. Shield shards feed this by raising the armor gained, and the armor also fills Arcane Battery for a large energy pool. Allies get the overguard too.
rules.build_impact: Frost becomes a strong squad overguard support. Build shields and armor, with Strength raising both the amount and the cap.

wiki.detail: Overguard scales with armor and Strength, capped at 15,000 scaled by Strength. The armor part counts once per enemy, and Frost's passive armor doesn't feed it for that same cast.

rules.reported: Each projectile that hits splits into four more, so multishot also multiplies the fragments and is very strong on Noctua. Unlike the Grimoire, it has no limit on how many tome mods it can take.
rules.build_impact: Prioritise multishot on the primary fire and fit as many tome mods as useful.

wiki.detail: Each extra projectile adds 4 fragments, which is linear growth rather than the exponential the creator says. Alt fire ignores multishot. A listed bug: any Punch Through stops fragments on the first target.

rules.reported: Noctua counts as both an ability and a secondary weapon, so it benefits from Pistol Amp and Arcane Precision and can trigger most Archon mods.
rules.build_impact: Warframe mods aimed at pistols are real damage on Dante, even without a held secondary.

wiki.detail: Names Pistol Amp and Arcane Precision. Archon Stretch triggers on Electricity status from Noctua.

rules.reported: Amalgam Barrel Diffusion on Noctua gives its dodge speed even when Noctua isn't in use.
rules.build_impact: A small mobility bonus for Dante if you already want multishot there.

wiki.detail: Describes the dodge speed but not this case, and Noctua's page doesn't cover it. Dante's patch history has no relevant change through 44.1.4.

rules.text_says: Passively scans enemies into the Codex.
rules.reported: Noctua gains 50% status chance against fully scanned enemies, and its passive scanning can also farm Kavat genetic codes.
rules.build_impact: Status chance on Noctua is better than the stat page shows against enemies you have fully scanned, and scanning is automatic with kills.

wiki.detail: Confirms kills scan into the Codex and the 50% status bonus. Kavat codes aren't mentioned.

rules.reported: Modded Strength raises both the healing and overguard and the overguard cap. The overguard also reaches companions and some objectives, including a defense objective the creator shows.
rules.build_impact: Strength is Dante's top stat for protection as well as damage, and he can protect an objective directly.

wiki.detail: The Strength scaling and the cap are confirmed. The page doesn't mention objectives, and Final Verse notes that rescue hostages don't receive Triumph's overguard.

rules.reported: Strength adds damage to Dark Verse but not more Slash procs, which stay at one per stroke. Pageflight is what lets it apply more. It breaks containers without line of sight but needs line of sight to damage enemies, and its reach follows Range.
rules.build_impact: Keep Pageflight up before Dark Verse and Tragedy to load more Slash for the burst.

wiki.detail: Confirms two Slash instances and the crate line of sight rule, and that Pageflight's vulnerability increases the procs per hit.

rules.reported: Tragedy works like Expedite Suffering on top of its own damage hit: it condenses all remaining Slash, Heat and Toxin damage over time into one instance.
rules.build_impact: Stack those three statuses first and use Tragedy as the finisher.

wiki.detail: Confirms the Slash, Heat and Toxin burst, with a 2.25-3x status multiplier and a 1 billion damage cap.

rules.reported: Tragedy removes the line of sight restriction, so it can damage enemies behind Dante.
rules.build_impact: Tragedy can catch enemies beside and behind you, but don't count on it through solid cover.

wiki.detail: Tragedy needs line of sight, though it is lenient: it checks from both Dante and the camera, traces rays to enemies beside and behind you, and skips the check within 5 m.

rules.reported: Word Warden's floating Noctua copies every mod on your Noctua at 50% of its damage and fires when you deal damage. Not all mods work as intended on it, multishot among them.
rules.build_impact: Mod Noctua even if you rarely fire it, since the copy takes those mods. Don't count multishot toward Word Warden's damage.

wiki.detail: Confirms 35-50% copied damage and mod inheritance. Its projectile ignores multishot and fire rate is fixed at 3, and it won't trigger Canticle or Invocation mods.

rules.reported: Pageflight's birds raise enemy status chance and status damage vulnerability up to 50%, scaling with Strength and multiplying with your mods, though not for forced procs. As summons, they work with Summoner's Wrath and Arcane Camisado.
rules.build_impact: A large multiplier for any status weapon used alongside Dante, including allies' weapons. Forced-proc weapons gain less from it.

wiki.detail: Confirms all of this, with forced procs excluded. A listed bug: Slash from the Paragrimms doesn't double dip on Summoner's Wrath.

rules.text_says: Increases blast radius.
rules.reported: On the Torid's Incarnon beam, Primed Firestorm adds two extra chain targets, despite being a blast radius mod on a beam.
rules.build_impact: A good pick for the last slot on an Incarnon Torid, since overkill damage spreads to more enemies. Either explanation favours it.
rules.creator_caveat: The creator wasn't sure of the exact chain count.

wiki.detail: Different mechanism: Firestorm widens the beam's 2.3 m damage radius, and each target in that radius chains to 5 more, so more targets chain. Torid's patch history shows no change since the video.

rules.reported: A Panzer Vulpaphyla with Viral Quills spreads Viral to enemies around you up to the full 10 stacks, a 4.25x damage multiplier, so your weapon need not carry Viral.
rules.build_impact: Frees a weapon's element choice, for example Corrosive against Grineer, and leaves room for reload speed or magazine mods.

wiki.detail: Up to 10 spores per enemy each apply Viral. Quills themselves only have 2.2% status despite the text saying 40%, but spores appear without needing a Viral proc. The spores are lost if the Panzer dies with Panzer Devolution equipped.
